name: Voygent
description:
Start with a rough idea and Voygent interviews you the way a good advisor would — who's going, when, what kind of trip, what matters most — then builds around your answers instead of a template. It runs live searches for flights, hotels, tours, and activities and lays the results out as boards you compare side by side and pick from, right in the chat. Every flight, hotel, and price comes from a live search result, never from the model's memory, and the plan is checked as it grows: dates that don't line up, missing pieces, numbers that don't add up.

Your trip is saved. Come back tomorrow or next month and ask for a change in plain language — swap the Tuesday hotel, add a day in Porto, push the whole thing a week later — and Voygent reworks the plan while keeping everything else intact.

When it's ready, Voygent renders the trip as a polished day-by-day itinerary page with your chosen flights, hotels, activities, and what you're paying. Keep the link, send it to whoever you're traveling with, or print it for the trip folder. Re-render any time and the same link picks up your changes.

All of that is free — the interview, the live searches, the comparison boards, and the itinerary. Options carry a direct booking link, and Voygent may earn a standard referral commission if you use one; it doesn't change your price or which options you're shown.

Built by travel professionals, so you get the kind of concrete, current answers a good advisor gives — grounded in live availability, not guesses.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voygent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voygent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://voygent.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voygent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voygent lists 47 MCP tools, including board, build_trip_map, car_rental_search, clean_fetch, clean_search, delete_trip, esim_search, excursion_search, find_trips, flight_compensation_check, flight_search, and generate_demo_trip.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voygent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Voygent in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Voygent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voygent is developed by Voygent.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
